name: Jerome Alexander Whitley Brennan
extra_bullets: Represented the department on the county's data governance working group and helped write its first data sharing agreement
Organized the annual funder site visit day, including tours, data summaries and meetings with program participants
Answered the client phone line two afternoons a week and referred callers to other county services
cover_letter_paragraph: I've also learned that good reporting depends on the people entering the data. I run a short training for program staff every quarter and check data quality across all programs, and our error rate on federal reports has dropped steadily since I started. I'd bring the same attention to your office's reporting.
